niche_preference_profile: Prefers calm, polished interfaces that usually feel light, muted, spacious, and editorial rather than loud or aggressively productized. They consistently like clear hierarchy, coherent section grouping, restrained color use, soft rounded geometry, integrated search and controls, and layouts that feel complete and thoughtfully organized. They often favor minimal visual noise, concise modular presentation, and understated premium styling over cluttered, fragmented, or overly promotional UI.

criteria.description: Prefers strong top-down hierarchy with prominent headings, clear sequencing, and easy-to-scan section progression.
Prefers content organized into clearly separated, well-labeled, coherent modules or sections rather than fragmented or awkwardly mixed groupings.
Prefers a calm, muted, understated visual mood with restrained contrast and a composed, polished feel rather than loud, harsh, or promotional styling.
Prefers softer, more generously rounded cards, buttons, and containers with cushioned geometry over sharper or rigid component shapes.
Prefers search bars and top chrome that blend softly into the layout and feel embedded rather than detached, bright, or visually pasted on.
Prefers icon accents in soft pastel or gently tinted treatments with lower visual aggression rather than saturated, loud icon tiles.
Prefers screens that feel fully populated, balanced, and intentionally completed rather than sparse, unfinished, or containing awkward empty areas.
Prefers text-led, decoration-light layouts with fewer distracting photos, extra controls, or competing UI elements.
Prefers contemporary editorial or refined product-system aesthetics over generic, conventional, or dated settings/onboarding patterns.
Prefers controls and row behaviors that feel uniform, simplified, and practically distributed, avoiding mixed patterns or unnecessary decision friction.
